run_query_chat_completion: run the query function to send a chat completion request to a custom LLM endpoint
create_query_function: create a query function that posts a JSON payload to a custom chat completions API
build_headers_with_auth: build an Authorization header using a Bearer token from an environment variable

summarize_response_choices: summarize the response by extracting the assistant message from choices[0].message
